div.head: Whiston’s chapter headings (compiled index)
div.note: These headings are transcribed from the 1856 Auburn and Rochester printing of William Whiston’s translation. Their arrangement as an index is editorial; this is not a reproduction of an original printed table of contents.
div.head: BOOK V.
div.p: CONTAINING THE INTERVAL OF FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-SIX YEARS.
FROM THE DEATH OF MOSES TO THE DEATH OF ELI.

list.label: I
list.item: HOW JOSHUA, THE COMMANDER OF THE HEBREWS, MADE WAR WITH THE CANAANITES, AND OVERCAME THEM, AND DESTROYED THEM, AND DIVIDED THEIR LAND BY LOT TO THE TRIBES OF ISRAEL.
list.label: II
list.item: HOW, AFTER THE DEATH OF JOSHUA THEIR COMMANDER, THE ISRAELITES TRANSGRESSED THE LAWS OF THEIR COUNTRY, AND EXPERIENCED GREAT AFFLICTIONS; AND WHEN THERE WAS A SEDITION ARISEN, THE TRIBE OF BENJAMIN WAS DESTROYED, EXCEPTING ONLY SIX HUNDRED MEN.
list.label: III
list.item: HOW THE ISRAELITES AFTER THIS MISFORTUNE GREW WICKED, AND SERVED THE ASSYRIANS; AND HOW GOD DELIVERED THEM BY OTHNIEL, WHO RULED OVER THEM FORTY YEARS.
list.label: IV
list.item: HOW OUR PEOPLE SERVED THE MOABITES EIGHTEEN YEARS, AND WERE THEN DELIVERED FROM SLAVERY BY ONE EHUD, WHO RETAINED THE DOMINION EIGHTY YEARS.
list.label: V
list.item: HOW THE CANAANITES BROUGHT THE ISRAELITES UNDER SLAVERY FOR TWENTY YEARS; AFTER WHICH THEY WERE DELIVERED BY BARAK AND DEBORAH, WHO RULED OVER THEM FOR FORTY YEARS.
list.label: VI
list.item: HOW THE MIDIANITES AND OTHER NATIONS FOUGHT AGAINST THE ISRAELITES, AND BEAT THEM, AND AFFLICTED THEIR COUNTRY FOR SEVEN YEARS. HOW THEY WERE DELIVERED BY GIDEON, WHO RULED OVER THE MULTITUDE FOR FORTY YEARS.
list.label: VII
list.item: THAT THE JUDGES WHO SUCCEEDED GIDEON MADE WAR WITH THE ADJOINING NATIONS FOR A LONG TIME.
list.label: VIII
list.item: CONCERNING THE FORTITUDE OF SAMSON, AND WHAT MISCHIEFS HE BROUGHT UPON THE PHILISTINES.
list.label: IX
list.item: HOW UNDER ELI'S GOVERNMENT OF THE ISRAELITES, BOOZ MARRIED RUTH, FROM WHOM CAME OBED, THE GRANDFATHER OF DAVID.
list.label: X
list.item: CONCERNING THE BIRTH OF SAMUEL; AND HOW HE FORETOLD THE CALAMITY THAT BEFELL THE SONS OF ELI.
list.label: XI
list.item: HEREIN IS DECLARED WHAT BEFELL THE SONS OF ELI, THE ARK, AND THE PEOPLE; AND HOW ELI HIMSELF DIED MISERABLY.
